title: Thinking on Manasi K & Computational Mama
summary: Kahran and Divya debrief on their back-to-back conversations with Manasi Khare and Computational Mama, finding a shared thread about identity — Manasi shape-shifting between selves, Computational Mama building an alter ego. They detour into Ways of Seeing and the male gaze, the cost of attaching yourself to an identity (the political party benefits, you bear the burden), and how an identity opens doors that weren't on your radar before.

intents.display: to think about identity as something you put on rather than something you are
